highlights.title: Little Mac Bridge
highlights.text: Students and organizations paint messages on this bridge, so it's always changing. See what's on it today!

highlights.title: Photo spot: Zumberge Pond
highlights.text: Stand on the pond's edge facing the Carillon for one of the most photographed views on campus.
